title: Easy Garlic Butter Chicken with Mashed Potatoes & Green Beans
contentHtml:
A no-fuss family dinner that tastes like you worked way harder than you did. This garlic butter chicken is golden on the outside, juicy inside, and served with creamy mashed potatoes and garlicky green beans. It is exactly the kind of weeknight dinner a busy dad can put on the table without turning the kitchen into a disaster zone.

Why You’ll Like This One

Everything is familiar, filling, and easy to find at the grocery store. The chicken cooks in one skillet, the garlic butter becomes the sauce, and the whole meal is ready in about 40 minutes.

Ingredients

Garlic Butter Chicken

  • 4 boneless, skinless chicken breasts
  • 4 tablespoons unsalted butter
  • 4 cloves garlic, minced
  • 1 teaspoon Italian seasoning
  • 1 teaspoon paprika
  • 1 teaspoon kosher salt
  • 1/2 teaspoon black pepper
  • 1 tablespoon olive oil

Mashed Potatoes

  • 1 1/2 pounds Yukon Gold or russet potatoes, peeled and cubed
  • 3 tablespoons butter
  • 1/2 cup milk
  • Salt and pepper to taste

Green Beans

  • 1 pound fresh green beans, trimmed
  • 1 tablespoon olive oil
  • 2 cloves garlic, minced
  • Salt and pepper to taste

How to Make It

  1. Start the potatoes. Add the cubed potatoes to salted water and boil until fork-tender, about 15 minutes.
  2. Season the chicken. Pat the chicken dry and season both sides with Italian seasoning, paprika, salt, and pepper.
  3. Sear the chicken. Heat olive oil and 1 tablespoon butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook chicken for about 5–7 minutes per side, depending on thickness, until the center reaches 165°F. Remove to a plate.
  4. Make the garlic butter. Reduce heat to medium-low. Add the remaining 3 tablespoons butter and 4 cloves minced garlic. Cook about 30 seconds, just until fragrant. Return the chicken to the skillet and spoon the garlic butter over it.
  5. Mash the potatoes. Drain the potatoes, add butter and milk, then mash until creamy. Season to taste.
  6. Cook the green beans. Heat olive oil in another skillet over medium heat. Add garlic for about 30 seconds, then green beans. Cook 6–8 minutes until tender-crisp. Season with salt and pepper.
  7. Serve. Plate the chicken with mashed potatoes and green beans. Spoon any extra garlic butter from the chicken skillet over the chicken and potatoes.

Dad Shortcut

If the evening is already getting away from you, use refrigerated mashed potatoes and steam-in-bag green beans. Make the chicken and garlic butter yourself and nobody at the table needs a full accounting of how dinner got there.

Meal Planning Notes

Servings: 4   |   Prep: 10 minutes   |   Cook: 30 minutes   |   Total: about 40 minutes

For a family of six, use 6 chicken breasts, about 2 1/4 pounds of potatoes, and 1 1/2 pounds of green beans. The ingredient quantities can also be adjusted with the meal-planning and recipe-scaling tools at Family Meal Planning Tools.
